tasks.title: Strict Microsoft PowerPoint Desktop Layout & Color Token System
tasks.description: Redesign the documentation workspace into a full-fidelity Microsoft PowerPoint application shell across both themes. Strictly enforce the exact design tokens and linear/radial CSS gradients: Dark Mode (Page background gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(210, 71, 38, 0.3) 0%, rgba(54, 54, 54, 0.2) 100%), #000000; chrome: rgba(38, 38, 38, 0.5); cards: rgba(54, 54, 54, 0.5); primary accent: #D24726; primary text: #E6E6E6; secondary text: #929299) and Light Mode (Page background: radial-gradient(206.32% 100% at 100% 100%, #797568 0%, #DFD8C0 100%), #FFFFFF; chrome: #E6DEC8; cards: rgba(245, 240, 230, 0.5); primary accent: #D24726; primary text: #302F28; secondary text: #797568). Implement the PowerPoint top title bar, ribbon toolbar, fixed left slide thumbnail strip (16:9 previews with active #D24726 selection outline), center presentation canvas, and bottom status bar with slide counter and zoom controls.

tasks.title: GSAP Slide Transition Engine & Hero ScrollTrigger Animations
tasks.description: Integrate GSAP and ScrollTrigger. On the landing/home hero section, implement staggered headline and code block entry animations triggered via ScrollTrigger. In the documentation viewport, implement a PowerPoint slide-change presentation experience: while the ribbon header and thumbnail sidebar remain stationary and pinned, scrolling vertically advances between presentation slide decks using smooth GSAP wipe/push transitions and snaps to subsequent documentation topics.

tasks.title: Consolidate Strict 4-Route Structure & Purge Extraneous Pages
tasks.description: Reconfigure Next.js App Router to strictly support ONLY the requested routes: '/' (Main home landing page), '/docs' (Documentation overview default), '/docs/installation' (Installation and project setup), '/docs/capabilities' (Capabilities and architectural features), and '/docs/api-reference' (Interactive API reference with all functions and examples). Completely delete and purge any legacy routes, orphaned pages, and unused data files (such as /features, /guides, /docs/api, and legacy test assets).

tasks.title: Refine Content JSON Schemas & Prune Unused Text
tasks.description: Align documentation data files under docs-site/src/data/ strictly to the approved routes. Audit apiReference.json, docsNavigation.json, and siteMeta.json to delete all obsolete categories, extraneous diagnostic methods, dead text, and placeholder stubs. Keep only clean, copyable code examples, exact method signatures, parameter tables, and valid OpenXML DOM impact details.

tasks.title: Comprehensive High-Ranking SEO, AI-Search Mode & Structured Data Engine
tasks.description: Optimize the entire portal to dominate #1 organic search rankings on Google/Bing and qualify for top generative citations in Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, and ChatGPT Search. Embed rich JSON-LD schemas (SoftwareApplication, TechArticle, FAQPage), compile docs-site/public/llms.txt specifically for LLM scrapers, generate standard sitemap.xml and robots.txt, implement 1200x630 OpenGraph and Twitter cards, and optimize package.json / README.md keywords targeting pure JavaScript PPTX template engine and serverless slide automation.

tasks.title: Static Export Verification, Agent Memory Sync & Final Build
tasks.description: Execute static compilation with `next build` verifying zero hydration errors and clean static HTML emission under docs-site/out/. Synchronize the .agent knowledge base (.agent/project_summary.md, .agent/rules/features.md) to reflect the PowerPoint layout, strict route layout, and GSAP slide transitions.
